guard_set.note: Two passes enforce train/eval disjointness: (1) difflib full-text ratio >= GUARD_RATIO catches near-identical phrasings; (2) TF-IDF cosine >= SEM_GUARD_COS catches semantic near-dups even across the third-person (Option-A scenario descriptions) vs first-person (bank user messages) phrasing gap. Observed max cosine is well below the threshold, so the bank is already disjoint from the Option-A 40 at the scenario level; the guard would catch real overlap on any future rescale.
